text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having witnessed Vivlos's stellar performance at the Oka Sho, a huge crowd of fans gathered again today to cheer her on. Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —There, your hair is fixed.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sister♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, Verxina also came to help out
as support for Vivlos, rather than just as a spectator.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the Oka Sho must have helped her
sort out her own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, big sis~
I want you to brush my hair some more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Don't touch!
After I went through all the trouble to fix it. Now it's perfect!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, then...
Give me headpats?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Geez, see? It's going to collapse now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Giggle...
You really are such a spoiled sweetie.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Partly because she was with her beloved older sister,
Vivlos was in high spirits. No fatigue remained from the Oka Sho, and her physical condition showed no major issues.
choice_data_list: The only thing left is the distance, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks is 2400m—a huge jump in distance compared to the Oka Sho, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Making adjustments in such a short period of time
was quite a struggle for me as well.
choice_data_list: I've got it covered in training.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The environment during the actual race will be completely different, after all.
I'm sure Vivlos will be fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec~!
No talking just between the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Me to—o!
Can you squeeze me in?"
choice_data_list: Ah, it is about you, after all
Yeah, it's your story after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I don't think that's all there is to it, though.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No more pampering now.
The race is about to start.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If it's you, you'll definitely be fine.
Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'll do my best!
choice_data_list: Come home safe again today, you hear?
Come home safe again today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, Trainer-san...
I'll come back a winner, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And when that happens...
you'd better pamper me a whole, whole lot! ♡
